note: Facility locations and footprints are reported by OpenStreetMap contributors. Dates are when OpenStreetMap first recorded a facility, not when it was built - OpenStreetMap carries no build dates. Power and water are a facility's share of a reported national total, allocated by building floor area, and are upper bounds. Only buildings carry that share: a campus mapped as a land parcel and a site mapped as under construction are counted and measured, but are given no power or water figure at all.
